issues.description: The replacement public `inv()` spec helper only forwards to `type_inv()` and has no justified consumer after the type-invariant migration.
issues.rationale: After removing the duplicate `Inv` trait implementation, this revision adds a public helper whose entire body is `self.type_inv()`. The collaborator asks where it is used; the following fix deletes the helper and removes its remaining contract call rather than establishing an abstraction-boundary consumer. `avoid-unused-spec-helpers` requires a current caller or a documented external abstraction need, not a compatibility alias introduced during cleanup.
issues.verification: source-only; historical Verus not executed. Inspected the original review commit, subsequent fix, final merged head, complete archived discussion, and complete live remote discussion.
